name: facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech_synthesis/preprocessing/denoiser/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.build_demucs_model: build a Demucs speech enhancement model with configurable depth, hidden channels, and kernel size
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.run_demucs_inference: run the Demucs model on a waveform tensor to enhance speech and remove noise
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.create_demucs_streamer: create a DemucsStreamer for real-time streaming speech enhancement with configurable dry signal mixing
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.test_demucs_streaming: test the Demucs streaming implementation against the offline batch model and benchmark RTF
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.review_blstm: review the BLSTM bidirectional LSTM wrapper class with optional linear projection layer

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.get_model_dns48: use get_model with default args to load the pre-trained DNS H=48 denoiser model
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.get_model_dns64: use get_model with dns64 flag to load the pre-trained DNS H=64 denoiser model
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.get_model_master64: use get_model with master64 flag to load the pre-trained DNS and Valentini H=64 model
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.get_model_local: use get_model with model_path arg to load a local trained denoiser model package
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.add_model_flags: use add_model_flags to add mutually exclusive model selection arguments to an argparse parser

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.upsample2_audio_tensor: upsample a PyTorch audio tensor by 2x using sinc interpolation with a Hann-windowed kernel
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.downsample2_audio_tensor: downsample a PyTorch audio tensor by 2x using sinc interpolation with a Hann-windowed kernel
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.kernel_upsample2_create: create a Hann-windowed sinc interpolation kernel for upsampling audio signals by a factor of 2
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.kernel_downsample2_create: create a Hann-windowed sinc interpolation kernel for downsampling audio signals by a factor of 2
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.sinc_compute: compute the sinc function on a PyTorch tensor, handling the t equals 0 edge case

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.deserialize_model_from_package: deserialize a PyTorch model from a serialized package dict with optional strict mode
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.serialize_model_to_package: serialize a PyTorch model with captured init args and state dict into a package dict
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.swap_model_state_temporarily: temporarily swap a model's state dict within a context manager and restore on exit
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.calculate_snr_between_tensors: calculate the signal-to-noise ratio between label and estimated PyTorch tensors
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.wrap_iterable_with_logprogress: wrap an iterable with LogProgress to log periodic progress updates with speed metrics
